[medical facility] for serious but non life threatening injuries to the head from the initial fall and her legs from the collision. there was a witness to these described events that provided statements to investigators. the written statement from the witness was forwarded to records for inclusion with this investigation. photos were taken of the scene and later uploaded to evidence. com. there was no airbag deployment in unit # 1 and no damage to this unit as a result of the collision.

[medical facility] for serious but non life threatening injuries to the head from the initial fall and her legs from the collision. there was a witness to these described events that provided statements to investigators. the written statement from the witness was forwarded to records for inclusion with this investigation. photos were taken of the scene and later uploaded to evidence. com. there was no airbag deployment in unit # 1 and no damage to this unit as a result of the collision.

records.public_safe_text: on september 7, 2019 at 1156 hours, police responded to [roadway], college station, brazos county, tx for an auto versus pedestrian accident. it occurred in a parking lot in front of t. j. maxx. unit 1 was driving east in the parking lot near the front entrance to t. j. maxx. unit 1 was attempting to take a left turn into one of the parking rows. unit 2 was walking out of the t. j. maxx heading north into the parking lot. as unit 2 walked into the parking lot they stepped down into the drainage area that is in the parking lot and at a lower level then the surrounding pavement. unit 1 was making the left turn in this area and could not see unit 2 due to the height of the vehicle compared to unit 2 walking through the part of the parking lot that was lower. unit 1 hit unit 2 with it's front left bumper. this caused unit 2 to fall face forward and land on their arms and knees. photographs of the injuries were taken and uploaded to evidence. com.
